claim: claim_id is the row identity anchor because validate_ledger rejects missing or duplicate values and treats each claim_id as a unique stable row key.
sub_question: Why is claim_id the row identity anchor?
evidence: Validator tracks seen_ids; empty claim_id errors as missing; repeats error as duplicate claim_id. Docs call it a stable ID such as C001.
quote_or_anchor: if not claim_id: errors.append(f"line {i}: missing claim_id"); elif claim_id in seen_ids: errors.append(f"line {i}: duplicate claim_id {claim_id}"); seen_ids.add(claim_id)
notes: Cross-checked references/evidence-ledger.md: claim_id | stable ID such as C001. Also used as dcterms:identifier / claim:{claim_id} in prov-export.
